# Brayden Wisniewski

> Designer. People person. Kinda tall. UX at SCAD, graduating March 2027. Open to design roles.

I'm Brayden, a designer who documents the process out loud.

## Work

- [Designing for people and AI agents](https://www.braydenw.com/ibm): A summer in Austin on how people and AI agents learn complex products. Product Design Intern at IBM, shipped on ibm.com.
- [Making focus feel a little easier](https://www.braydenw.com/opal): New features for the Opal focus app: plan, focus, and take breaks worth taking. Product Designer, Indigo Design Award.
- [Capture a moment, together](https://www.braydenw.com/presents): A private time capsule for a small group of friends. Designer & iOS build, SVSD Design Sprint.
- [Making Slack’s hidden state visible](https://www.braydenw.com/slack): Two everyday tasks most people couldn’t finish. Two small changes fixed both. Research Lead, 3/8 → 8/8 task success.
